staticReview.finding: Only explicit behavior:instant was added to both text/image scrollIntoView calls. This positions geometry synchronously before unchanged hit-testing; no acceptance condition or visibility fallback was removed.

Original DOM equality, unique revision container, mutation history including restored text, ancestor visibility, image geometry/filter/mask/srcset checks, text paint proof, resource restrictions and final integrity remain unchanged. Existing paint proof already uses instant scrollBy.

Three regressions isolate offscreen text in smooth viewport, text in smooth nested scroller, and image-only viewport geometry. Root red log shows 0/3 before fix; green log shows 3/3 after fix. These exact three tests were not rerun by this reviewer.

New test retains partial/public_files=1/ORIGINAL_NOT_VERIFIED and uncertain release; no automatic materialization retry; revoked original actor and currently authorized publisher perform read-only recognition; remote ID/URL/revision/old actor and full media row retained; one total materialization, two reads, no publish/unpublish/projection and no repeated command.

Read-only recovery selects current recovery Actor and access purpose, while beforeWrite rejects recovering and beforeMaterialize rejects recovery without explicit new media. New media rechecks current authority, command binding, lease, pause and final fingerprint. The renderer patch does not alter these boundaries.
